decisions.decision: Committee will hold a working session with the committee on Thursday, then meet in January.
decisions.quote: greg roy stated we will have a working session with the committee on thursday then meet in january.

decisions.decision: Civil engineers will send a draft to the committee to verify, and architects will check with the town manager before sending the draft.
decisions.quote: tom stated the civil engineers will send back a draft to the committee to verify and architects will check

decisions.decision: Asbestos is to be abated, along with any lead paint in areas that will be occupied.
decisions.quote: matthew allison stated to abate the asbestos and any areas of lead paint that will be occupied.

decisions.decision: Cove base and adhesive in the classrooms is to be removed.
decisions.quote: greg roy said just get rid of it.

decisions.decision: Existing furniture is to be re-used; only what is needed is to be bought, with bid alternatives added back if the project comes in under bid.
decisions.quote: greg roy stated use as much as we have, only buy what we need, and add some back in if we come in under bid.

decisions.decision: Architects to ask the department heads about current needs and expectations for furniture.
decisions.quote: tom lam stated he would reach out to the department heads on current needs

decisions.decision: Architects asked to provide a life cycle cost analysis for significant finishes such as flooring and counters.
decisions.quote: greg roy stated on some significant things like flooring and counters

decisions.decision: Ed DiSalvio to talk to engineering about the specific property line and what is owned by the town.
decisions.quote: ed disalvio stated said he would talk to engineering and ask about a specific property line and owned by the town.

decisions.decision: Ed DiSalvio to attend a future meeting on the traffic study; traffic study to go to DPW for future work.
